title: pleopeltis soromanes
intro: Pleopeltis soromanes, commonly known as the "Mexican polypody", is a species of epiphytic fern native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and inflammation, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis soromanes include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and treating respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
